posts.text: Ouch: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung’s lengthy post on the World Cup team’s failure to advance to the round of 32 calls the team leadership (i.e., coach) “incompetent,” blames mismanagement, calls on the government to investigate and push for sports administration reform.
posts.summary: South Korean political figure criticizes sports administration mismanagement
